description:
Generate JavaDoc HTML documentation for the 'DevUtils' Java project in Eclipse IDE.

The DevUtils project is a utility library containing five Java classes across three packages:
- com.devutils.text: StringUtils, CaseFormat
- com.devutils.math: MathUtils, Statistics
- com.devutils.collection: ListUtils

All classes have comprehensive JavaDoc comments with @param, @return, @throws, @author, and @since tags.

Your task:
1. If the 'DevUtils' project is not visible in the Project Explorer, import it from ~/eclipse-workspace/DevUtils (File > Import > General > Existing Projects into Workspace).
2. Open the Generate Javadoc wizard (Project menu > Generate Javadoc...)
3. Configure the Javadoc command: ensure it points to '/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64/bin/javadoc'
4. Select the 'DevUtils' project (ensure all packages are checked)
5. Set visibility to 'Protected' (to capture public and protected members)
6. Set the Destination to: '/home/ga/javadoc-output'
7. Click Finish to generate the documentation.
8. Verify the documentation was generated successfully (check the Console for errors).
